_readme: design/v2 i18n supplement — keys the shipping catalogue (snapshots/ui_translations.json) does NOT have.
This file is BOTH the mockup's runtime fallback AND the Phase-2 i18n key backlog:
every key here must be added to the product catalogue (src/i18n) before the redesign ships.
Rule for Tasks 8-12: never hardcode a visible string. If the catalogue lacks the key, add it here with zh + en.
Resolution order is catalogue -> supplement (see js/core/i18n.mjs); keys that exist in the catalogue must NOT be duplicated here.

v2_al_fmt_bp.en: best-practices: {ok, output, summary}, with mode/added/replaced/skipped/total and backup_id (config.py:888-896).

v2_al_fmt_debug.zh: debug：output 是 run_debug_mode 期間擷取並去除 ANSI 的 stdout（actions.py:560-566），通常有數十行。
v2_al_fmt_debug.en: debug: output is the stdout captured during run_debug_mode with ANSI stripped (actions.py:560-566), usually dozens of lines.

v2_al_fmt_err.zh: 失敗一律是 {ok:false, error, description}，前端不會把它當成完成（actions.js:60-72）；429 rate_limit_exceeded 也走這條。
v2_al_fmt_err.en: Failures always come back as {ok:false, error, description} and are never reported as completed (actions.js:60-72); a 429 rate_limit_exceeded uses the same shape.

v2_al_fmt_run.zh: run：{ok, output}，output 是「分析週期與警報發送完成」這類單行摘要（actions.py:531）。
v2_al_fmt_run.en: run: {ok, output}, where output is a one-line summary such as "analysis cycle and alerts completed" (actions.py:531).

v2_al_fmt_test.zh: test-alert：output 是 channel=status 的摘要，另外 results[] 每筆由前端印成 channel: status -> target | error（actions.js:97-101）。
v2_al_fmt_test.en: test-alert: output is a channel=status summary, and each results[] entry is printed by the front end as channel: status -> target | error (actions.js:97-101).

v2_al_fmt_wm.zh: reset-watermark：{ok, cleared[], output}，cleared 列出真正被清掉的 key（actions.py:629-633）。
v2_al_fmt_wm.en: reset-watermark: {ok, cleared[], output}, where cleared lists the keys actually removed (actions.py:629-633).

v2_al_fn_bw_metric.zh: 選項值就是規則儲存的 type：bandwidth（Mbps 峰值）或 volume（MB 累計）。
v2_al_fn_bw_metric.en: The option value is the rule's stored type: bandwidth (peak Mbps) or volume (cumulative MB).

v2_al_fn_cooldown_remaining.zh: 剩餘冷卻分鐘數，由 alert_history 與 cooldown_minutes 算出（rules.py:110-126），不是儲存欄位。
v2_al_fn_cooldown_remaining.en: Minutes of cooldown left, computed from alert_history and cooldown_minutes (rules.py:110-126); not a stored field.

v2_al_fn_desc.zh: 告警內文用的說明。表單沒有這個欄位——建立時後端直接抄規則名稱（rules.py:171）。
v2_al_fn_desc.en: The description used in the alert body. The form has no field for it: the create endpoint copies the rule name (rules.py:171).

v2_al_fn_desc_flow.zh: 流量／頻寬規則的說明＝規則名稱（rules.py:275/365）。
v2_al_fn_desc_flow.en: For flow and bandwidth rules the description is the rule name (rules.py:275/365).

v2_al_fn_desc_system.zh: 系統規則的說明由後端以 rule_pce_health_desc 填入（rules.py:209）。
v2_al_fn_desc_system.en: For system rules the backend fills the description from rule_pce_health_desc (rules.py:209).

v2_al_fn_filter_key.zh: 事件規則固定為 event_type（rules.py:168）；matcher.py:60-66 只比對事件的 event_type，不讀這個欄位。
v2_al_fn_filter_key.en: Always event_type for event rules (rules.py:168); matcher.py:60-66 matches on the event's event_type and never reads this field.

v2_al_fn_filter_scalar.zh: 規則裡既有的單數篩選欄位（rules.py:41-47）；由上方 FilterBar 讀入與改寫。
v2_al_fn_filter_scalar.en: The singular filter fields already stored on the rule (rules.py:41-47); read and rewritten by the FilterBar above.

v2_al_fn_flow_threshold.zh: 流量／頻寬規則固定為 count（rules.py:277/367）；表單沒有門檻型別選項。
v2_al_fn_flow_threshold.en: Flow and bandwidth rules are fixed at count (rules.py:277/367); the form has no threshold-type control.

v2_al_fn_i18n_key.zh: 內建規則的字典鍵，由 apply_best_practices 寫入（config.py:775-795）；手動建立的規則沒有這個欄位。
v2_al_fn_i18n_key.en: Catalogue key for a built-in rule, written by apply_best_practices (config.py:775-795); hand-made rules do not carry it.
v2_al_fn_i18n_key._note: read-only field note for name_key / desc_key / rec_key

v2_al_fn_match_system.zh: 系統規則永遠是空的 match_fields（rules.py:215）；matcher.py 的欄位比對只走事件規則。
v2_al_fn_match_system.en: System rules always carry an empty match_fields (rules.py:215); matcher.py's field matching only runs for event rules.

v2_al_fn_name_event.zh: 事件規則的名稱不是輸入的：saveEvent 取事件目錄的標題（rules.js:519-520）。
v2_al_fn_name_event.en: An event rule's name is not typed: saveEvent takes the catalogue title (rules.js:519-520).

v2_al_fn_proto_bw.zh: 頻寬／傳輸量規則的 proto 一律寫入 None（rules.py:355/374）——沒有通訊協定選項可設。
v2_al_fn_proto_bw.en: Bandwidth and volume rules always store proto as None (rules.py:355/374) — there is no protocol control to set it.

v2_al_fn_rec.zh: 告警的建議處置。表單沒有這個欄位——建立時後端填預設字串（rules.py:172，gui_rule_default_rec_check_logs）。
v2_al_fn_rec.en: The recommended action shown in the alert. No form field: the create endpoint writes a default string (rules.py:172, gui_rule_default_rec_check_logs).

v2_al_fn_rec_flow.zh: 流量規則填 gui_rule_default_rec_check_policy、頻寬規則填 gui_rule_default_rec_check_logs（rules.py:275/365）。
v2_al_fn_rec_flow.en: Flow rules get gui_rule_default_rec_check_policy, bandwidth rules gui_rule_default_rec_check_logs (rules.py:275/365).

v2_al_fn_rec_system.zh: 系統規則的建議處置由後端以 rule_pce_health_rec 填入（rules.py:210）。
v2_al_fn_rec_system.en: For system rules the backend fills the recommendation from rule_pce_health_rec (rules.py:210).

v2_al_fn_sys_threshold.zh: 系統規則固定為 immediate / 1 / 10（rules.py:211-214）：健康檢查一失敗就觸發，只有冷卻可調。
v2_al_fn_sys_threshold.en: System rules are fixed at immediate / 1 / 10 (rules.py:211-214): a failed health check fires at once and only the cooldown is configurable.

v2_al_fn_throttle.zh: 每小時發送上限（例：1/15m）。R5 之後 UI 不再提供這個欄位（rules.js:86、index.html:2673 註解），既有值仍保存在後端並生效。
v2_al_fn_throttle.en: Per-rule send cap (e.g. 1/15m). The UI stopped offering it after R5 (rules.js:86, index.html:2673 comment); stored values are kept and still enforced.

v2_al_fn_throttle_state.zh: 後端每次讀取時計算的抑制計數（rules.py:127-131）：cooldown_suppressed / throttle_suppressed / next_allowed_at。
v2_al_fn_throttle_state.en: Suppression counters recomputed on every read (rules.py:127-131): cooldown_suppressed / throttle_suppressed / next_allowed_at.

v2_al_fn_type.zh: 規則型別，由建立端點決定（rules.py:167/205/269/355），之後不可改。
v2_al_fn_type.en: Rule type, fixed by the create endpoint (rules.py:167/205/269/355); it cannot be changed afterwards.

v2_al_scope_body.en: Rule conditions, thresholds and filters are edited here; every drawer prints the exact payload and endpoint it would send.

v2_al_scope_ops.en: Running an analysis, sending a test alert or resetting the watermark all live in the ops sub-view.

v2_al_test_note.zh: 命中判定是 src/events/matcher.py:8-89（matches_event_rule）的逐句移植，跑在快照裡的原始事件上，因此這裡的數字是真的。兩點差異要知道：(1) Python re 與 JavaScript RegExp 是不同引擎，罕見的 regex 樣式可能不一致；(2) 產品的 /api/events/rule_test（events.py:203-300）是反過來問「某條規則會命中最近哪些事件」，而且會同時跑 legacy matcher（shadow.py:34）做對照。

Two known differences: (1) Python's re and JavaScript's RegExp are different engines, so an exotic pattern could disagree; (2) the product's /api/events/rule_test (events.py:203-300) asks the inverse question — which recent events a given rule matches — and also runs the legacy matcher (shadow.py:34) for comparison.

v2_au_check_flow.zh:
POST /api/rule_scheduler/check
  with _rs_db_lock:      # 與其他寫入路由共用同一把鎖
      db.load()          # 先重讀，避免整檔覆寫互相清掉
      logs = engine.check(silent=True, tz_str=...)
  _append_rs_logs(logs)  # deque(maxlen=200)
  return {ok: true, logs: [...去除 ANSI...]}
v2_au_check_flow.en:
POST /api/rule_scheduler/check
  with _rs_db_lock:      # shared with every other writing route
      db.load()          # re-read first; whole-file writes must not clobber
      logs = engine.check(silent=True, tz_str=...)
  _append_rs_logs(logs)  # deque(maxlen=200)
  return {ok: true, logs: [...ANSI stripped...]}
v2_au_check_flow._note: AU-09 code pane; transcribed from rule_scheduler.py:432-445

v2_au_check_real.zh: 真實行為：POST /api/rule_scheduler/check 會在寫入鎖裡重讀排程庫、跑一次 engine.check(silent=True)、把產生的行寫進伺服器的紀錄環，再去掉 ANSI 色碼回傳（rule_scheduler.py:432-445）。也就是說，按下去就會真的切換 PCE 規則。
v2_au_check_real.en: What really happens: POST /api/rule_scheduler/check re-reads the schedule store inside the write lock, runs engine.check(silent=True) once, appends the produced lines to the server's log ring and returns them with ANSI stripped (rule_scheduler.py:432-445). Pressing it really does toggle PCE rules.
v2_au_check_real._note: AU-09 honest description of the real endpoint

v2_au_dec_note.en: The rules are transcribed statement by statement from rule_scheduler.py:302-399: the draft gate first (a block means no action), then whether a one_time entry has expired and whether a recurring window contains the moment, then the action decides the target state. This is a computation, not a result: nothing toggled, nothing logged, the appliance never hears about it.

v2_au_detail_only.en: Only ruleset {id} has a captured rule list (the capture pins rs_ruleset_detail to rs_rulesets.items[0].id — test_capture_snapshots.py:91-101). On a live appliance every ruleset fetches its rules from the PCE on click.

v2_au_dow_off_list._note: AU-11/AU-12 list-cell flag for an unmapped day_of_week, same pattern as v2_au_rep_type_off_list

v2_au_dow_unknown.zh: 這筆排程存的 day_of_week 是「{value}」，不在產品下拉選單的七個值裡（monday…sunday，index.html:1638-1645、config_models.py:124）。排程比對用 now.strftime("%A").lower()（report_scheduler.py:259），只會產生 monday…sunday，永遠不會等於「{value}」——這筆排程實際上從未在預期的星期觸發，這是產品端的真實 bug，不是本頁的簡化。這裡把原值保留成一個選項並標記 ⚠，不做靜默正規化。
v2_au_dow_unknown.en: This schedule stores day_of_week "{value}", which is not one of the product dropdown's seven values (monday…sunday, index.html:1638-1645, config_models.py:124). The match is now.strftime("%A").lower() (report_scheduler.py:259), which only ever produces monday…sunday — it can never equal "{value}", so this schedule has in fact never fired on its intended day. This is a real product bug, not a simplification made here. The stored value is kept as an option and marked ⚠ instead of being silently normalized.
v2_au_dow_unknown._note: AU-11 unknown day_of_week warning (fix round I2) — mirrors v2_au_rep_type_unknown's keep-and-flag treatment

v2_au_expire_engine.zh: 到期時間一過，引擎會 disable 並 provision 目標，成功才刪掉排程與 PCE 註記；失敗就保留排程、下一輪重試（rule_scheduler.py:355-378，2026-07-24 審查 BUG-1 的修法：不可讓規則留在 enabled 卻沒人管）。
v2_au_expire_engine.en: Once the moment passes the engine disables and provisions the target, and only removes the schedule and the PCE note if that succeeded; on failure the schedule stays and the next tick retries (rule_scheduler.py:355-378 — the 2026-07-24 review fix: a rule must never be left enabled with nobody watching it).

v2_au_fmt_hint.zh: 表單只存一個值；選「全部格式」時儲存會展開成 html + csv + xlsx 三種（dashboard.js:443-444）。
v2_au_fmt_hint.en: The form stores one value; choosing all expands to html + csv + xlsx on save (dashboard.js:443-444).

v2_au_job_asof.zh: 所有「距今」都是相對快照擷取的那一刻（{at}），不是你現在的時間。
v2_au_job_asof.en: Every age is measured against the capture instant ({at}), not your clock.

v2_au_job_beat._note: AU-13 column head for the age/interval meter

v2_au_job_beat_note.zh: 節拍為本設計新增（DESIGN-ADDED）：長條是「上次執行距快照時刻」占 interval 的比例，刻度就是一個 interval，超過刻度代表這一拍已經遲了。兩個值都由 job_health 既有欄位相減得出，沒有另外取數，也沒有重新判定 level。
v2_au_job_beat_note.en: The beat meter is DESIGN-ADDED: the bar is the age of the last run at capture time as a fraction of the job's interval, and the tick is exactly one interval, so anything past the tick is a late beat. Both figures are subtraction on fields already in job_health — no extra fetch, and level is never re-judged.

v2_au_job_hist_note.zh: 誠實說明：後端每個 job 只保存「上次執行」一筆（last_run / last_status / detail），沒有逐次執行的歷史端點，所以這裡不畫執行時間軸。要看實際發生了什麼：規則排程的逐輪紀錄在「規則排程」子頁，其餘 job 走系統日誌。
v2_au_job_hist_note.en: Stated plainly: the backend keeps only the LAST run per job (last_run / last_status / detail); there is no per-run history endpoint, so no run timeline is drawn here. For what actually happened: the rule scheduler's per-tick log is on the rule-schedule sub-view, and everything else is in the system logs.

v2_au_job_level_note.zh: level 由後端判定，此頁不重算：error＝上次執行失敗、warn＝從未執行或已逾期、ok＝正常（integrations.js:1502-1503）。狀態欄只有在 warn 且確實跑過時才接「逾期」兩字（:1513-1515）。
v2_au_job_level_note.en: level is the backend's verdict and is not recomputed here: error = the last run failed, warn = never ran or overdue, ok = healthy (integrations.js:1502-1503). The status cell appends 逾期 only when a warn job HAS run before (:1513-1515).

v2_au_job_ok_note.zh: level 為 ok 的 job

v2_au_jobs_intro.zh: 這是排程與整台機器的心跳：上面兩個子頁的排程都靠這些背景 job 觸發。總覽只給一個燈，這一頁給每一個 job 的間隔、上次執行，以及離下一拍還有多久。
v2_au_jobs_intro.en: This is the heartbeat under both schedule pages: every schedule above is fired by one of these background jobs. The overview shows one light; this page shows each job's interval, last run and how far it is into its own beat.

v2_au_kind_mismatch.zh: 型態與 href 不一致

v2_au_kind_note.zh: 目標欄同時標示型態與位址。型態取自 href：ruleset 是 /rule_sets/<id>，rule 則在後面再多一段 /sec_rules/、/rules/ 或 /deny_rules/（三種規則集合，rule_scheduler.py:160-166）。欄位 is_ruleset 是表單當時的宣告，而它並非裝飾——api_client.py:1325 用它決定要 provision 的範圍（is_ruleset 為真就 provision 這個 href，否則往上取到父 ruleset）。兩者不一致代表切換打在這個物件、卻 provision 了另一個範圍，所以就地標紅，不靜默取其一。
v2_au_kind_note.en: The target column states kind and address together. The kind comes from the href: a ruleset ends at /rule_sets/<id>, a rule adds one more pair of segments — /sec_rules/, /rules/ or /deny_rules/ (the PCE's three rule collections, rule_scheduler.py:160-166). is_ruleset is what the form claimed, and it is not decoration: api_client.py:1325 uses it to choose the provision scope (the href itself when true, otherwise the parent ruleset). A disagreement means the toggle lands on one object while another scope is provisioned, so it is flagged in place rather than silently resolved.

v2_au_kpi_snapday.zh: 快照的執行紀錄止於 {day}：當日 {runs} 次檢查、{hits} 次切換、{errors} 次錯誤。上面四格用的是產品自己的算式（以瀏覽器當日午夜為界，rule-scheduler.js:783-795），靜態快照必然落在 0——這一行讓那個 0 讀起來是日期問題，不是排程器停擺。
v2_au_kpi_snapday.en: The captured log ends on {day}: {runs} checks, {hits} toggles, {errors} errors that day. The four figures above use the product's own arithmetic (the browser's midnight, rule-scheduler.js:783-795), which on a static snapshot is always zero — this line makes that zero read as a date, not as a dead scheduler.

v2_au_log_cap.zh: 紀錄是行程內的環狀緩衝，上限 200 筆，最舊的自動淘汰（src/gui/__init__.py:103）；快照剛好抓滿 200 筆。「清除」只清畫面，伺服器那份不動（rule-scheduler.js:640-643）——這是產品行為，不是本頁的簡化。
v2_au_log_cap.en: The history is an in-process ring buffer capped at 200 entries, oldest evicted (src/gui/__init__.py:103); the snapshot caught exactly 200. Clear empties the pane only and leaves the server's copy alone (rule-scheduler.js:640-643) — that is the product's behaviour, not a mockup shortcut.

v2_au_log_clear_note.zh: 只清掉畫面上的輸出；伺服器的紀錄環沒有被動到。
v2_au_log_clear_note.en: Cleared the pane only; the server's ring buffer is untouched.

v2_au_mock_run.en: On a real appliance this starts a background thread and the state moves running → success or failed; here only the running state is shown so the transition is visible.

v2_au_mock_save.zh: mockup 不會呼叫 API：只改了這一頁記憶體中的副本，離開路由就還原。

v2_au_mock_toggle.zh: 只切換了畫面上的副本。

v2_au_name_hint.zh: 同時送出 name 與 detail_name（rule-scheduler.js:449, :456）；清單的描述欄讀的是 detail_name。

v2_au_note_en.zh: 這段字會寫進 PCE 物件的 description 欄位，固定使用英文——它是不透明資料，之後的報表會原樣輸出，寫中文會流進 EN 模式的稽核報表（rule_scheduler.py:357-360）。註記寫入失敗時整筆排程回滾並回 502（:375-390）。
v2_au_note_en.en: This string goes into the PCE object's description and is always English — it is opaque data that later report runs surface verbatim, so Chinese would leak into EN-mode audit reports (rule_scheduler.py:357-360). If the note write fails the whole schedule is rolled back and the call answers 502 (:375-390).

v2_au_pf_draft.en: Draft-only objects cannot be scheduled (the POST answers 400).

v2_au_pf_note.zh: 真實的三道關卡都在寫入之前、且一律 fail-closed：has_draft_changes 為真 → 400；get_provision_state 回 unknown → 502「PCE 沒有回應」（刻意與 draft 分開講，否則操作者會去找一個不存在的 draft）；狀態不是 active → 400。（rule_scheduler.py:302-330）mockup 沒有 PCE，這裡以快照的 provision_state 代打，並標明它代表哪一關。
v2_au_pf_note.en: All three real gates run before anything is stored and all fail closed: has_draft_changes true → 400; get_provision_state unknown → 502 "the PCE did not answer" (deliberately worded apart from the draft case, or the operator hunts a draft that does not exist); state not active → 400. (rule_scheduler.py:302-330) The mockup has no PCE, so the captured provision_state stands in — and says which gate it stands for.

v2_au_pf_ok.zh: 目標目前是 ACTIVE，可以建立排程。
v2_au_pf_ok.en: The target is ACTIVE; a schedule can be created.

v2_au_pf_unknown.zh: 這一層沒有擷取到部署狀態；真實環境會在這一步即時向 PCE 問一次。
v2_au_pf_unknown.en: No provisioning state was captured at this level; a live appliance asks the PCE at this point.

v2_au_pick_ruleset.zh: 從左側挑一個 ruleset 以檢視它的規則。

v2_au_recon_note.zh: 對帳三態逐條轉錄自 rule_scheduler.py:258-300：抓 ruleset 失敗＝未知（維持原狀，不會把排程標成已刪除）；href 找得到＝顯示 PCE 上的 enabled 並清掉舊的 deleted 旗標；href 找不到＝標成已刪除。產品把三態壓成一個徽章，這裡分開講，因為「未知」和「已刪除」要處理的問題不一樣。
v2_au_recon_note.en: The three states are transcribed from rule_scheduler.py:258-300: the ruleset fetch failed → unknown (nothing is re-flagged; a schedule is never marked deleted on a fetch error); the href resolves → show the PCE's enabled and clear any stale deleted flag; the href is gone → mark deleted. The product collapses all three into one badge; they are kept apart here because unknown and deleted are different problems.

v2_au_recon_unknown._note: AU-08 reconciliation state: the ruleset fetch failed, so live state is unknown

v2_au_rep_app_on.zh: app_summary 會多出 app / env 兩個欄位，且 app 為必填（dashboard.js:447-449）。
v2_au_rep_app_on.en: app_summary adds the app / env fields, and app is required (dashboard.js:447-449).

v2_au_rep_del_i1.zh: 排程本身會被刪除，之後不再產生新報表。
v2_au_rep_del_i1.en: The schedule is deleted; no further reports are produced.

v2_au_rep_del_i2.zh: 已經產出的報表檔案不受影響，仍留在報表清單裡。

v2_au_rep_filters_off.zh: 此報表類型沒有流量篩選區；儲存時也不會送出 filters（dashboard.js:446）。

v2_au_rep_filters_on.zh: 此報表類型會顯示流量篩選區（FilterBar）與政策決策選項（dashboard.js:383-387）；mockup 不重複搬一份 FilterBar，改在此註明。

v2_au_rep_hist_empty.en: The appliance's state file has no run record for this schedule yet (last_run is empty too).

v2_au_rep_hist_note.en: Stated plainly: GET /api/report-schedules/<id>/history reads the schedule's CURRENT state row from the state file and returns it as a one-element list, or an empty one (reports.py:1221-1232) — it is not a per-run history. So this page does not draw it as a timeline.

v2_au_rep_type_unknown.zh: 這筆排程存的 report_type 是「{type}」，不在產品表單的十一個選項裡（index.html:1591-1603、dashboard.js:317-329）。產品開啟這張表單時把 select.value 設成這個不存在的值（dashboard.js:401），瀏覽器對不存在的 <option> 一律回傳 selectedIndex=-1、value=""——不是「落回第一個選項」；按儲存時 saveSchedule() 讀到的就是這個空字串，PUT 送出 report_type=""（清空欄位，不是改成別的類型，dashboard.js:450）。這裡把原值保留成一個選項並標記 ⚠，讓它不會被默默清空。

Opening the form sets the select's value to this nonexistent value (dashboard.js:401); a browser <select> given a value with no matching <option> reports selectedIndex=-1 and value="" — it does NOT fall back to the first option. Saving reads that empty string and PUTs report_type="" (the field is CLEARED, not changed to another type, dashboard.js:450). Here the stored value is kept as a real option and marked ⚠ so it cannot be silently blanked.

v2_au_reports_intro.en: Report schedules change no policy; they produce files and mail them. Every key report_schedules carries is listed: the ones the form owns are editable, the rest are marked backend-written with their origin — a field swallowed by a form is exactly how the last redesign lost data.

v2_sy_ch_schema_src.en: Every field on these cards is generated from the /api/alert-plugins schema: input_type picks the control, value_type drives the coercion before send, and config_path decides where the value is written back.

v2_sy_log_raw_note.zh: 這一行就是產品對一筆日誌的全部呈現：時間、層級、訊息串成一行純文字。
v2_sy_log_raw_note.en: That single line is the product's entire rendering of a log entry: timestamp, level and message concatenated as plain text.

v2_sy_mock_save.zh: 此 mockup 不會寫入任何設定。「儲存」只把基準值更新為畫面上的值，並把上方 request 印出來。
v2_sy_mock_save.en: This mockup writes nothing. Save only moves the baseline to what is on screen and prints the request above.

v2_sy_payload._note: the live payload pane every settings page ends with

v2_sy_pce_active_field.zh: 作用中的 profile id；沒有 profile 時為 null
v2_sy_pce_active_field.en: the active profile id; null when there are no profiles

v2_sy_pce_add_src.zh: 轉錄自 settings.js:370-383（表單）與 :753-773（addPceProfile，送出 action:'add'）。
v2_sy_pce_add_src.en: Transcribed from settings.js:370-383 (the form) and :753-773 (addPceProfile, which sends action:'add').

v2_sy_pce_i_cache.zh: 本地快取仍是舊 PCE 的資料，直到重新輪詢為止
v2_sy_pce_i_cache.en: The local cache still holds the old PCE's data until it re-polls

v2_sy_pce_i_nocfm.en: DESIGN-ADDED: the product switches with no confirmation at all (settings.js:775-783)

v2_sy_pce_i_queries.zh: 之後所有查詢、報表與告警都改打新的 PCE
v2_sy_pce_i_queries.en: Every query, report and alert then targets the new PCE

v2_sy_pce_i_switch.zh: 將作用中的 PCE 切換為「{name}」

v2_sy_pce_none_body.zh: 這台設備目前直接使用下方的 api.* 連線設定，沒有具名 profile。建立 profile 後才能在多台 PCE 之間切換。
v2_sy_pce_none_body.en: This appliance uses the api.* connection below directly; there are no named profiles. Profiles are what makes switching between PCEs possible.

v2_sy_pce_payload_src.zh: 送出：POST /api/settings，body 只帶被改動的區段（settings.js:689-698）。
v2_sy_pce_payload_src.en: Sends POST /api/settings whose body carries only the touched sections (settings.js:689-698).

v2_sy_pce_profile_field.zh: 設定檔名稱，只作標記用；不影響連線
v2_sy_pce_profile_field.en: a label on the stored config; it does not affect the connection

v2_sy_pce_save_note.zh: 這一區存的是 settings.api，與上方的 profile 清單是兩份資料：沒有 profile 時，這裡就是唯一的連線設定。
v2_sy_pce_save_note.en: This block writes settings.api, which is separate from the profile list above: with no profiles it is the only connection there is.

v2_sy_pce_switch_bug.zh: 切換成功的訊息用的是 gui_pce_switched，訊息裡的 {name} 由前端填入所選 profile 名稱——後端不回傳名稱，所以刪除後再切換會顯示空白。
v2_sy_pce_switch_bug.en: The success message uses gui_pce_switched with {name} filled in by the client from the selected profile; the backend returns no name, so a switch after a delete shows a blank.

v2_sy_pce_url_rule.zh: 必須是完整 URL，含 scheme 與 port。
v2_sy_pce_url_rule.en: Must be a full URL including scheme and port.

v2_sy_restart_i_409.zh: 若 daemon 由 systemd／NSSM 等外部管理，後端會回 409，需從服務管理器重啟
v2_sy_restart_i_409.en: If the daemon is managed externally (systemd, NSSM…) the backend answers 409 and the restart must come from the service manager

v2_sy_restart_i_poll.zh: 重新載入輪詢間隔與排程
v2_sy_restart_i_poll.en: Reloads the poll intervals and schedules

v2_sy_restart_i_rate.zh: 重置速率限制計數與進行中的批次
v2_sy_restart_i_rate.en: Resets the rate-limit counters and any in-flight batch

v2_sy_ret_counters.zh: 回報的計數只涵蓋事件與流量兩類，後端實際還會清理其他資料表。
v2_sy_ret_counters.en: The reported counters cover events and flows only; the worker also sweeps other tables.

v2_sy_ret_i_409.zh: 刪除後不可復原；已封存的資料不受影響
v2_sy_ret_i_409.en: Deleted rows cannot be recovered; archived data is untouched

v2_sy_ret_i_agg.zh: 刪除超過 {n} 天的彙總流量
v2_sy_ret_i_agg.en: Deletes aggregated flows older than {n} days

v2_sy_ret_i_events.zh: 刪除超過 {n} 天的事件

v2_sy_ret_i_nobody.zh: 請求不帶 body，天數一律以伺服器端目前的設定為準
v2_sy_ret_i_nobody.en: The request carries no body; the day counts come from the server's current config

v2_sy_ret_i_raw.zh: 刪除超過 {n} 天的原始流量
v2_sy_ret_i_raw.en: Deletes raw flows older than {n} days

v2_sy_saved.zh: 已提交 {n} 項變更（{endpoint}）——此 mockup 不會真的送出。
v2_sy_saved.en: Committed {n} changes ({endpoint}) — this mockup sends nothing.

v2_sy_sec_authsetup.zh: true 表示已經離開初始密碼；GET /api/security 有回傳，但產品的表單不顯示它
v2_sy_sec_authsetup.en: true means the bootstrap password is no longer in use; GET /api/security returns it and the product's form shows it nowhere

v2_sy_sec_lockout.zh: 留空＝不限制來源。填錯會把自己鎖在外面，改動前請先確認你目前的來源位址在清單內。
v2_sy_sec_lockout.en: Blank means no restriction. Getting this wrong locks you out — check that your own address is in the list before you save.

v2_sy_sec_oldpw.zh: 這個表單不需要舊密碼——已登入的 session 就是授權
v2_sy_sec_oldpw.en: this form takes no old password; the authenticated session is the authorisation

v2_sy_sec_payload_src.zh: 送出：POST /api/security {username, new_password, allowed_ips}。確認欄只在前端比對，不會送出。
v2_sy_sec_payload_src.en: Sends POST /api/security {username, new_password, allowed_ips}. The confirm box is compared on the client and never sent.

v2_sy_sec_pw_rule.zh: 至少 12 個字元；留空表示不變更密碼。
v2_sy_sec_pw_rule.en: At least 12 characters; leave blank to keep the current password.

v2_sy_sec_rotate.zh: 改密碼會讓其他既有 session 失效，你自己這一個也會需要重新登入。
v2_sy_sec_rotate.en: Changing the password invalidates other sessions, and you will have to sign in again yourself.

v2_sy_secret_hint.en: Leave blank to keep the stored value.

v2_sy_secret_note.zh: DESIGN-ADDED：後端把機密換成遮罩並附上 __set／__length（config.py:428-431），產品把遮罩直接塞回密碼框、丟掉這兩個旁欄。這裡改成陳述狀態，永遠不重建值。
v2_sy_secret_note.en: DESIGN-ADDED: the backend replaces secrets with a mask and adds __set/__length siblings (config.py:428-431); the product puts the mask back in the password box and drops both siblings. Here the state is stated and the value is never reconstructed.

v2_sy_secret_short.zh: 由伺服器的 __set／__length 旁欄推得，不是值本身
v2_sy_secret_short.en: derived from the server's __set/__length siblings, never from the value

v2_sy_siem_fw_src.zh: 轉錄自 integrations.js 的 forwarder 設定區；送出 PUT /api/siem/forwarder {enabled, dispatch_tick_seconds, dlq_max_per_dest}。
v2_sy_siem_fw_src.en: Transcribed from the forwarder block of integrations.js; sends PUT /api/siem/forwarder {enabled, dispatch_tick_seconds, dlq_max_per_dest}.

v2_sy_siem_i_dlq.zh: 該目的地累積的 DLQ 一併消失
v2_sy_siem_i_dlq.en: Its accumulated DLQ entries go with it

v2_sy_siem_maskpii_note.zh: PII 遮罩開關，同樣沒有 UI 入口——預設 false 代表不遮罩
v2_sy_siem_maskpii_note.en: the PII masking switch, also unreachable from the UI; the default false means no masking

v2_sy_siem_name_new.zh: 建立後不可變更；名稱同時是 API 路徑。
v2_sy_siem_name_new.en: Fixed once created; the name is also the API path.

v2_sy_siem_name_ro.zh: 名稱是這個目的地的位址，編輯時不可改。
v2_sy_siem_name_ro.en: The name is this destination's address and cannot be changed while editing.

v2_sy_siem_noack_help.zh: UDP 沒有傳送確認，送出即視為成功，因此這個目的地不會產生 DLQ。
v2_sy_siem_noack_help.en: UDP has no delivery confirmation: a send counts as success, so this destination can never produce DLQ entries.

v2_sy_siem_nomodal.zh: 目的地有、但 modal 不顯示的欄位
v2_sy_siem_nomodal.en: Stored on the destination, absent from the modal

v2_sy_siem_payload_src.zh: 送出：PUT /api/siem/forwarder。目的地的建立／更新是各自的請求，見目的地 drawer 內的 request 區塊。
v2_sy_siem_payload_src.en: Sends PUT /api/siem/forwarder. Destination create/update are separate requests — see the request block inside the destination drawer.

v2_sy_siem_port_auto.zh: 切換傳輸方式時，只有當目前的 port 仍是預設值（514/6514/8088）才會自動改寫。
v2_sy_siem_port_auto.en: Switching transport rewrites the port only while it is still one of the defaults (514/6514/8088).

v2_sy_siem_profile_note.zh: 建立時採預設值，UI 沒有任何入口可以設定
v2_sy_siem_profile_note.en: takes its default on create; no UI reaches it

v2_sy_siem_sent._note: siem_status.sent is a lifetime total; gui_ov_sent words it as a 7-day figure

v2_sy_siem_st_fallback.zh: 兩個都不勾時後端會退回 [audit, traffic]（等於全開），不是「都不送」。
v2_sy_siem_st_fallback.en: With neither ticked the backend falls back to [audit, traffic] — that is everything, not nothing.

v2_sy_siem_test_body.zh: 測試送出打的是「已儲存」的那份目的地設定，不是畫面上還沒存的值。
v2_sy_siem_test_body.en: The test posts to the SAVED destination, not to whatever is unsaved on screen.

v2_sy_siem_test_err.en: the failure reason when ok is false

v2_sy_siem_test_mock.zh: 此 mockup 沒有可連線的目的地，測試不會送出。
v2_sy_siem_test_mock.en: This mockup has no reachable destination; nothing is sent.

v2_sy_siem_test_ok.zh: 是否成功連線並送出一筆測試事件
v2_sy_siem_test_ok.en: whether a test event connected and was sent

v2_sy_siem_test_req.zh: POST /api/siem/destinations/{name}/test — 此 mockup 不會送出。

v2_sy_siem_test_saved.zh: 因此新建或改設定後要先儲存，測試才有意義。
v2_sy_siem_test_saved.en: So a new or edited destination has to be saved before a test means anything.

v2_sy_stop_btn._note: the imperative the button, the palette command and the confirm all share; gui_action_gui_stopped_title is the resulting state and stays on the strip

v2_sy_stop_i_cli.zh: 恢復必須回到主機命令列，網頁上沒有任何入口
v2_sy_stop_i_cli.en: Recovery is from the host command line; there is no way back from the browser

v2_sy_stop_i_persistent.zh: 以服務方式常駐時後端會回 403 並拒絕停止——但產品的按鈕不會告訴你
v2_sy_stop_i_persistent.en: In persistent/service mode the backend answers 403 and refuses — which the product's button never tells you

v2_sy_stop_i_sigint.zh: 對 GUI 行程送出停止訊號，網頁介面立即無法連線
v2_sy_stop_i_sigint.en: Signals the GUI process to stop; the web interface becomes unreachable immediately

v2_sy_stop_mock.zh: 此 mockup 不會停止任何行程。

v2_sy_stop_swallow.zh: 產品的停止動作把回應吞掉，所以 403（拒絕停止）與 200（已停止）在畫面上長得一模一樣。
v2_sy_stop_swallow.en: The product's stop action swallows the response, so a 403 (refused) and a 200 (stopped) look identical on screen.

v2_sy_tf_cidr_bug.zh: 欄位說明寫「CIDR 或精確 IP」，但前端的 validateIp 沒有接受 / 的分支（integrations.js:521-526），後端 config_models 也一樣拒絕——CIDR 實際上是無效輸入。IPv6 分支只檢查十六進位與冒號，所以「::::」會通過。
v2_sy_tf_cidr_bug.en: The field help promises "CIDR or exact IP", but validateIp has no branch that accepts a slash (integrations.js:521-526) and config_models rejects it too — CIDR is not actually valid input. The IPv6 branch only checks hex and colons, so "::::" passes.

v2_sy_tf_presave.zh: 這些提示只是提示：產品在儲存前不會擋下無效的 IP 或 Port，錯誤要等後端回應才會出現。
v2_sy_tf_presave.en: These are hints only: the product does not block a save on an invalid IP or port; the error arrives with the backend response.

v2_sy_tls_csr_mock.zh: CSR 由伺服器產生並回傳 PEM；此 mockup 沒有後端，因此沒有可複製或下載的內容。
v2_sy_tls_csr_mock.en: The CSR is generated server-side and returned as PEM; with no backend here there is nothing to copy or download.

v2_sy_tls_i_rate.zh: 舊憑證會被就地覆寫，沒有備份
v2_sy_tls_i_rate.en: The old certificate is overwritten in place, with no backup

v2_sy_tls_i_restart.zh: 續期後必須重啟伺服器才會套用新憑證
v2_sy_tls_i_restart.en: The server must be restarted before the new certificate is served

v2_sy_tls_i_selfonly.zh: 只適用自簽憑證；CA 簽發的憑證後端會拒絕
v2_sy_tls_i_selfonly.en: Self-signed only; the backend rejects this for a CA-signed certificate

v2_sy_tls_import_mock.zh: 此 mockup 不會匯入憑證。

v2_sy_tls_import_paste.zh: 匯入是貼上 PEM 文字，不是上傳檔案；憑證鏈請一併貼上。
v2_sy_tls_import_paste.en: Import takes pasted PEM text, not a file upload; paste the chain along with the leaf.

v2_sy_tls_no_renew.zh: 目前是 CA 簽發的憑證，續期不適用——請改用下方的 CSR 與匯入流程。
v2_sy_tls_no_renew.en: This is a CA-signed certificate, so renew does not apply — use the CSR and import flow below.

v2_sy_tls_ou_note.zh: 後端接受 ou 欄位，但產品沒有任何輸入框會產生它
v2_sy_tls_ou_note.en: the backend accepts an ou field that no input in the product produces

v2_sy_tls_payload_src.zh: 送出：POST /api/tls/config。CSR 與匯入各自是獨立端點。
v2_sy_tls_payload_src.en: Sends POST /api/tls/config. The CSR and the import are separate endpoints.

v2_sy_tls_subject_literal.zh: 主體字串直接來自 openssl 輸出，未經解析；產品也是原樣顯示。
v2_sy_tls_subject_literal.en: The subject string comes straight from openssl and is shown unparsed, exactly as the product shows it.

v2_sy_ts_note.zh: 取樣只作用在 Allowed 流量，Blocked 與 Potentially Blocked 全數保留；比例採確定性雜湊，同一條連線每次結果一致。
v2_sy_ts_note.en: Sampling applies to allowed flows only; blocked and potentially-blocked are always kept in full. The ratio is a deterministic hash, so a given flow always lands the same way.

v2_verify_pane.zh: 驗證面板｜僅樣本，實作不出現
v2_verify_pane.en: Verification pane · sample only, not in the product
v2_verify_pane._note: badge on every payload/stored-fields preview pane (verifypane.mjs)
